recap.text: Vinata stands at the crawler's shoulder during a warlord council and asks him how he will manage when his family is gone. She uses a god of light named Khepri to hide her party inside Club Vanquisher. Carl and Vinata both receive ninety seconds of immortality inside Khepri's temple. Carl sets a bomb, and a sluggalo bursts out of his back to put a hatchet between Vinata's eyes when her ninety seconds end.

beats.headline: A whisper at the warlord council
beats.text: I come and stand at the crawler's shoulder while the council goes on around us, and I put a small question to him quietly, so that he alone hears it. Cascadia has just learned her husband and most of her family are gone, and look at her. How does he imagine he will manage when his own is? He tells me his family is already dead. So I tell him that is not the family of which I speak, and I watch him understand which one I mean.
beats.gist: Vinata stands at the crawler's shoulder and asks him how he will manage when his own is gone.

beats.headline: The door into Club Vanquisher
beats.text: The Sultanate's trick is older than this season of theirs. One of the warlord's guards worships a god of light; the god summons its worshipper to a temple inside Club Vanquisher; the warlord's party travels with her, out of reach of anybody hunting the castle. The usual name on that list is Theia, and this season Theia is sponsored by someone in the pay of the Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network, so this season the god is Khepri, and a few weeks at a table crawling with beetles. It is a small price for being nowhere anybody can find.
beats.gist: Warlord Vinata travels to a temple inside Club Vanquisher to remain hidden from hunters.

beats.headline: The trap has two immortals inside it
beats.text: They come through the portal into Khepri's temple, the crawler and Katia and the goat, with Samantha opening the door for them. Standing this near this god hands a very few of us ninety seconds of immortality, and it does not enquire whose side they are on. His patch gives him his ninety. Being what I am gives me mine.

beats.headline: Ninety seconds each, and hers runs out first
beats.text: Warlord Vinata of the Blood Sultanate is dead. Crawler Carl set a bomb down inside the temple and stood in the middle of it, and everything in that room without a god's blessing went with the blast. Two of them had one. The crawler and the warlord came out through the doorway wrapped around each other, and while they were still on the ground his slugpox returned to him, and a sluggalo burst out of his back and put a hatchet between her eyes the moment her ninety were spent. The portal is open. There are gods walking out of it into Club Vanquisher.
beats.gist: Carl sets a bomb in a temple, and a sluggalo kills Warlord Vinata with a hatchet.

relations.note: The crown's outstanding requirement is paid in her nagas.
Vinata's court usually hides in her temple
